title: [Expense Agent] Fix administrative recall history access
summary: Expense Report recall authorization is now restricted to the submitter or users with Unlimited Expense Approval, and non-submitter recalls are recorded as administrative activity outside the approval history.
key_points: Only the expense report submitter or users with Unlimited Expense Approval permission can recall pending expense reports
Non-submitter recalls are recorded as BC User activity with Administrator role
Administrative activity is kept separate from submitter and approver history participation
Covers genuine submitter, mapped and unmapped administrator, and unauthorized recall scenarios
quote: authorize pending expense report recall only for the captured submitter or a user with Unlimited Expense Approval
